name: psst
description: For the Claude Code desktop app on Windows with an Android phone: icons of the apps that have notifications on your phone above the prompt, a count, and /phone to read them; /phone notices on adds a short notice when one arrives. Reads what Windows Phone Link already stores on the PC; makes no network requests and passes no notification content to Claude.

apps.title: Only these apps
apps.description: Comma-separated app names or Android package names to show, matched whole and ignoring case (for example: Gmail, com.google.android.gm). Empty shows every app.

ignore.title: Ignore these apps
ignore.description: Comma-separated app names or package names never to show, matched the same way. An app in both lists is ignored.

content.title: Notification text
content.description: show: the title and text appear in notices and the pane. hide: a notice shows only the app and 'new notification', a card the icon, the app, the time and 'New notification', and the title and text are dropped before anything is kept in session state.

ongoing.title: Playback and ongoing notifications
ongoing.description: hide: leave out playback controls (a video or music app) and notifications the phone keeps up while something runs; the /phone pane says how many were left out. show: count them and give them short notices like any other.

databaseFolder.title: Phone Link database folder
databaseFolder.description: Leave empty to use the first phone folder found. Set it only if you link more than one phone, to the folder ...\LocalCache\Indexed\<phone>\System\Database.
